subjects.name: Genesis II Church of Health and Healing

summary: Self-styled archbishop Jim Humble promoted Miracle Mineral Solution, an industrial bleach, as a cure-all through his Genesis II Church, while Kerri Rivera spread it as a fake autism cure given to children as drinks and enemas.

evidence.note: MMS discovered while gold prospecting in South America; first dosing in Guyana
host finds no reliable records of Humble before the late 1990s and no birth date
long segment on Humble's alien abduction and space god claims
church money routed to the Dominican Republic; Humble likely living in Mexico
Humble claims trials on prisoners and paid training trips in Haiti
detailed account of an eleven-year-old boy dosed under Rivera's protocol
Rivera ran her autism clinic in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico
UK case and London activist Emma Dalmain infiltrating the Facebook groups
Amazon, YouTube, Yahoo and Facebook deplatforming Rivera in 2019

notes: The packet says Humble's birth date is unknown, so lifespan is null and covered years start at the MMS discovery; 1996 is from outside knowledge, not the transcript (some sources give his birth as 1932/33, which would trigger the lifetime rule). Part 2 is mostly Kerri Rivera; she could arguably be primary. Africa travels and a Calgary convention are passing mentions.
